proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C p r s t hABC hr hs ht h1 h2 h3
  let T : Affine.Triangle ℝ P := ⟨![A, B, C], affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.mpr hABC⟩
  let R : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![r, s, t]
  have hR : ∀ i, R i ≠ 0 := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    exacts [hr, hs, ht]
  have hp : ∀ i : Fin 3, p ∈ line[ℝ, T.points i, AffineMap.lineMap (T.points (i + 1)) (T.points (i + 2)) (R i)] := by
    intro i; fin_cases i
    exacts [h1, h2, h3]
  have := Affine.Triangle.prod_div_one_sub_eq_one_of_mem_line_point_lineMap hR hp
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_three] at this
  exact this
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C p : P) (r s t : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → r ≠ 0 → s ≠ 0 → t ≠ 0 → p ∈ line[ℝ, A, AffineMap.lineMap B C r] → p ∈ line[ℝ, B, AffineMap.lineMap C A s] → p ∈ line[ℝ, C, AffineMap.lineMap A B t] → r / (1 - r) * (s / (1 - s)) * (t / (1 - t)) = 1
